signature.headline: Five things most POS systems get wrong
signature.sub: Built for how shops actually run — credit, outages, local taxes and the truck that leaves at 7 am.

khata.label: 01 · Digital credit ledger
khata.title: The credit notebook, made tamper-proof
khata.body: Every sale, payment and adjustment posts automatically with a running balance the shopkeeper can't accidentally fudge and the customer can't dispute. Share a PDF statement over WhatsApp in one tap.

accounting.label: 02 · Accounting on autopilot
accounting.title: Books that write themselves
accounting.body: A real double-entry general ledger posts from every sale, purchase, payment, expense and payroll run. You never touch a journal entry; your accountant opens clean books.

van.label: 03 · Van sales & distribution
van.title: Load the truck. Sell the route. Reconcile by evening.
van.body: Treat a vehicle as a mobile warehouse: load stock, sell and collect cash door-to-door — credit sales included — then match cash, goods and fuel at day end, with any shortfall on the driver's account.

offline.label: 04 · Works offline
offline.title: A dropped connection isn't a reason to stop selling
offline.body: When the internet drops, the till keeps ringing sales and syncs everything back safely when it returns — no duplicates, no lost transactions.

steps.drop: Internet drops. Till switches to offline mode.
steps.queue: 14 sales rung and receipted, queued locally.

tax.label: 05 · Local tax compliance
tax.title: Local tax rules built in, not bolted on
tax.body: Real-time e-invoicing where regulators require it, with a QR code on every receipt. Withholding tax, regional structures and multi-currency billing handled per country.

faq.headline: Questions merchants ask us
faq.sub: Still unsure? Write to us on WhatsApp or book a 20-minute demo.

0.a: A point-of-sale and complete back office for small and medium businesses: selling, stock, purchasing, customer credit, accounting, staff, delivery and an online store on one login — localised for how shops run in your country.

1.q: Which devices does it run on?
1.a: Any browser, a Windows desktop app (macOS and Linux too), and Android phones and tablets. iOS is coming soon. Thermal receipt printers, barcode scanners and cash drawers are supported.

2.a: English everywhere, plus local languages that switch on by country — with full right-to-left layout and instant switching inside the app.

3.q: Can I bring my existing products?
3.a: Import from CSV or Excel. Shopify and WooCommerce exports are detected automatically, so migration takes an afternoon.

0.q: What is the digital credit ledger?
0.a: Your running credit ledger, kept automatically. Every sale, payment and adjustment posts with a running balance that can't be quietly edited — and a PDF statement you can share on WhatsApp.

1.q: Can customers see their own balance?
1.a: With the Customer Portal extension, credit customers log in to see their ledger and invoices and pay online.

2.q: Does it handle supplier credit too?
2.a: Yes. Suppliers get the same running ledger, with aging, advances and payment allocation across invoices.

3.a: Per customer, enforced at the till, with alerts as a customer approaches the limit.

0.q: What happens when the internet drops?
0.a: You keep selling. Sales queue on the device and sync back when the connection returns — no duplicates, no lost transactions.

1.a: Each business's data is isolated at the database level, access is role-based, and two-factor authentication and a full audit log are included.

2.a: The general ledger posts itself from daily activity; your accountant gets clean double-entry books, statements and Excel exports.

0.a: Three months, every module, no card required. Nothing is switched off during it — the restaurant pack, van sales, accounting and all 31 extensions are included.

1.a: We agree a price that fits the size of your business. There are no published tiers to grow out of, and no per-module upsells or transaction fees — payment-gateway processing fees are set by the gateway, not by us.

2.q: Which currencies can I pay in?
2.a: Your local currency. Billing, tax rules and payment methods follow the country the shop is registered in.

3.q: Do I need a card to start?
3.a: No. Start the trial, and talk to us when you are ready — by email or on a 20-minute call.
